name: jasna
one_liner: A free desktop app that finds and digitally un-blurs mosaic-censored patches in videos and images, mainly used on Japanese adult videos, running entirely on your own gaming GPU.
buyer: An individual hobbyist with a gaming PC; this is a consumer novelty app, not something a legitimate business builds on.
business_use_cases: No credible mainstream business use case: its core function is reversing censorship on adult content, which most payment processors, ad networks, and app stores won't support.
A video restoration studio could in theory reuse its general mosaic-removal technique on non-adult archival footage with similar artifacts, but that is a stretch beyond its stated purpose.
Its paid 'supporter model' tiers show there is some willingness to pay among hobbyists, but it is donation-style support for a hobby project, not a scalable business.

money_ideas.idea: The project itself already monetizes via donation-gated supporter models for better restoration quality.

steal_this: Not recommended as a weekend business project: the core use case sits in a legal and ethical gray area tied to adult content, and most normal business infrastructure (payments, hosting, app stores) will reject it.
